name: Lim-Dûl
title: The Necromancer of the Ice Age
role: Necromancer and commander of undead armies
summary: A powerful necromancer whose ambitions and undead forces threatened the kingdoms of Terisiare during Dominaria's long winter.
biography: Lim-Dûl pursued magical and political power during Dominaria's Ice Age, when the kingdoms of Terisiare were already strained by generations of environmental hardship and warfare.
His mastery of necromancy allowed him to raise and command undead forces, adding a supernatural threat to the conflicts of the frozen kingdoms.
Jodah and Jaya Ballard became important opponents of Lim-Dûl. Resistance to his ambitions encouraged cooperation between the rival Kjeldoran and Balduvian factions.
Lim-Dûl became one of the enduring figures associated with the Ice Age storyline. His legendary creature card appeared in Time Spiral, years after the original Ice Age expansion.

The necromancer's power compounded Terisiare's vulnerability: casualties could become further threats to the living. This altered the stakes for settlements facing winters, conflict and limited resources even before their rulers could agree on a response.

His influence is best understood as a pressure on several political communities rather than a single uninterrupted campaign with universally agreed dates. The eventual alliance opposing him was also a struggle to overcome older divisions between the Kjeldoran and Balduvian peoples.

The Time Spiral printing used in this archive is a retrospective character portrait. Its rules and art communicate Lim-Dûl's association with the undead but do not depict every phase of his Ice Age campaign.

featuredCard.significance: A Time Spiral depiction of Lim-Dûl, whose undead armies threatened Terisiare.

source.title: Wizards of the Coast — The Legends You'll Find in Dominaria United
